text:
nina: Kicking off crosslang canary publish for SDK v3.0.0-canary.1 during tonight's quiet window.
alejandro: go for it, please include smoke test when both packages are up.
deploy-bot: publish attempt 1745678901 by nina
deploy-bot: outcome: npm published (@redwood/sdk-ts@3.0.0-canary.1), pypi uploaded (redwood_sdk_py==3.0.0rc1)
priya: running smoke now against example-app. hitting error in TS client auth: \"Missing x-rwd-auth\" in outbound requests. Python client ok.
nina: weird, CI for ts publish passed unit tests. Link to failing log: https://ci.redwood.example/abc123
alejandro: looks like the auth header codegen change slipped into TS canary build. Maybe feature branch merged after the lint step.
priya: stack snippet: ```Error: Request failed - 401
 at sendRequest (/workspace/node_modules/@redwood/sdk-ts/dist/index.js:120:23)
 at async main (/workspace/examples/smoke.js:6:5)```
ops-watchdog: creating short incident for crosslang-smoke-fail (INC-2024-233).
priya: quick repro locally with npm install @redwood/sdk-ts@3.0.0-canary.1 shows same 401.
nina: decision options: a) yank canary and republish after fix, b) keep canary but add dist-tag canary-hold and block promotion to stable, c) patch quickly and republish canary. My preference: don't yank npm to avoid churn for other tests.
alejandro: agree, add canary-hold tag and block any stable promotions. We'll patch and republish.
docs-bot: reminder: if we delay stable >24h, add note in changelog draft about canary hold.
priya: I'm opening a PR that reverts the auth change in TS codegen branch. PR #901 opened.
nina: applying temporary tag: `npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk-ts@3.0.0-canary.1 canary-hold`
deploy-bot: dist-tag action recorded 1745679200 by alejandro
alejandro: dist-tag added, confirmed: `npm dist-tag ls @redwood/sdk-ts` shows canary-hold mapped.
priya: will run full smoke after PR merge and bumped package. ETA ~20m.
ops-watchdog: incident updated: status acknowledged, impact low (smoke only), owners assigned (priya/nina).
priya: PR merged and new canary published as 3.0.0-canary.2
deploy-bot: publish attempt 1745679500 by priya - outcome: success (npm and pypi artifacts)
priya: re-running smoke: TS auth fixed, example-app passes basic flow.
nina: removing canary-hold tag to allow promotion gating once we finish docs: `npm dist-tag rm @redwood/sdk-ts canary-hold`
deploy-bot: dist-tag removal recorded 1745679600 by alejandro
docs-bot: created release notes draft PR #902 with a short note: \"Canary 3.0.0 staged; initial canary encountered TS auth regression and was held for an immediate fix. Stable promotion delayed pending crosslang verification.\"
alejandro: good. we'll hold stable promotion until tomorrow morning when platform team can run the extended integration matrix.
priya: follow-up: add CI check to verify generated auth header in TS smoke job to catch this earlier. I'll open an issue.
ops-watchdog: incident INC-2024-233 resolved 1745679680 - root cause: premature merge of auth-change.
nina: final: canary flows healthy, no rollback needed, we held promotion and patched quickly. Thanks folks. :rocket:
